shots.dialogue: 陳興道: 家を空け、庭を空けよ。敵に与える糧を、一粒も残すな。
shots.prompt: a stoic veteran general standing on a hilltop overlooking a retreating army, raising a hand to give a calm command, commanding cloak in the wind, dignified wide shot, overcast light

shots.narration: 人々は自らの家を焼いた。敵に何も残さぬために。
shots.prompt: villagers setting fire to their own homes and fields and walking away, the girl staring at her burning birthplace biting her lip, sorrowful, embers rising, emotional wide-to-close shot, ash falling

shots.dialogue: トアン: 逃げてばかりで、国が守れるのか！ / 陳興道: 国を捨ててでも、民が生きれば国は残る。
shots.prompt: the boy angrily confronting the veteran general, who answers calmly and firmly, tense face-to-face two-shot, torchlight, emotional, depth of field

shots.dialogue: 脱歓: もぬけの殻だと……。小癪な真似を。
shots.prompt: the Mongol commander Toghan riding into an empty deserted capital city, no food no people, growing frustration on his face, hollow streets, cold grand wide shot, grey light

shots.dialogue: 陳興道: 我ら、同じ大地に生きる者。屈すれば末代までの恥ぞ。
shots.prompt: the veteran general reading an exhortation aloud to gathered soldiers in a war camp at night, soldiers' eyes lighting with resolve, the boy clenching his fist among them, firelit, stirring

shots.dialogue: マイ: 家は焼けた。でも……あなたたちがいれば、また作れる。 / トアン: 俺が、必ず取り返す。全部。
shots.prompt: by a campfire, the boy sitting close to the girl who lost her home, a quiet promise between them, warm intimate firelight, gentle two-shot, soft mood

shots.dialogue: マイ(叫ぶ): トアン……っ！
shots.prompt: Mongol scouts raiding a column of fleeing refugees, chaos and dust, the girl seized and dragged onto a horse, reaching out and screaming, dynamic urgent camera, dramatic danger

shots.dialogue: トアン: マイ――！ 離せ、貴様ら！
shots.caption: ――次回、殺韃の誓い。
shots.prompt: the boy spinning around at the scream, drawing his sword and sprinting, his path blocked by a wall of Mongol cavalry, desperate fury, hard cut to black, dramatic cliffhanger
